note: This pointer stands in for the 9.2 MiB ladder_sweep.json, which is bulk run data and is hosted in the public Quilt package rather than in git, matching the convention 009.02 established for sweep.json. Only ladder_analysis.py needs it: run the fetch command above to place the real file at experiments/sfp_representation/009_ladder_artifacts/ladder_sweep.json before running 'ladder_analysis.py --check'. Every other ladder module's --check path is self-contained and needs nothing fetched. Regenerating it locally instead of fetching costs about 2820 s of GPU-free CPU time via 'ladder_sweep.py'.
purpose: all 2688 ladder runs: 2 blocks x 4 arms x 21 structural folds x 8 seeds, each carrying one Rung-1 and one Rung-2 run

run_digests.note: primary_rung1 and repair_rung1 are the SAME digest by construction: the declared Rung-2 repair touches only Rung 2, so the Rung-1 runs are bit-identical across blocks. That equality is a built-in consistency check on the block separation.

quilt_hash.note: The Quilt manifest hashes entries with its own chunked scheme, so this value is expected to differ from the plain-file 'sha256' above. It is not a mismatch. Use 'sha256' to verify a fetched file with shasum.
